title: A Formal Graph-Theoretic Framework for Pitch Class Set Analysis
summary: We present a graph-theoretic reformulation of pitch-class set theory in which each set in $\mathbb{Z}_n$ is represented as a complete weighted graph whose edge weights are interval classes. We show that this construction is invariant under the dihedral group $D_n$, and that the full interval structure is encoded by a cyclic step composition, from which all interval data are recovered via an additivity principle.
